A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same GeNI-ADMM work and provide readable text, equations, tables, figures and appendices. Reliable comparison is possible, including identifying the removal of v2's Appendix B; Appendix A remains in v3.

before.justification: Section 8 and Figures 1–4 report original convergence experiments on realsim for lasso, logistic regression and elastic net, including tests of the sketch-and-solve correction term.

after.justification: Section 8 and Figures 1–4 retain these original experiments and their convergence results.

M1.justification: Algorithms 2–4 retain the same GeNI-ADMM updates, inexact subproblem framework, NysADMM specialization and sketch-and-solve correction. The added GeNIOS reference describes another work's extension rather than a changed proposed procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate lasso, l1-logistic regression and elastic net on realsim. No dataset, task, domain or evaluation scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The experiments retain exact ADMM, NysADMM, GD-ADMM and sketch-and-solve ADMM. The added Zhao et al. row in Table 1 summarizes prior theoretical work; it introduces no new empirical comparator.

E3.justification: Retained settings agree, including 10,000 sampled examples, sketch sizes 50 and 500, regularization choices and the logistic preconditioner's 20-iteration refresh interval. v3 removes some setting descriptions but specifies no replacement protocol; these documentation losses are assessed under D1.

E4.justification: Section 8.3 and Figure 4 retain the same correction-term ablation: uncorrected sketch-and-solve diverges for lasso and fails to converge for logistic regression. No supplementary empirical analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Neither version reports empirical repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests or uncertainty bands. Their uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All 13 plot panels in Figures 1–4 are identical between versions. The findings also remain unchanged: NysADMM closely tracks exact ADMM, curvature-based methods outperform GD-ADMM, and uncorrected sketch-and-solve fails. No empirical result entries are added or removed.

T1.justification: Definition 4 replaces leading-eigenvector incoherence with an eigenbasis-wide condition, and Proposition 2 replaces its spectral bound with d/(mu_V intdim(H_f)). Table 2 drops the sigma I regularization term. v3 also corrects Lemma 3's sign and Lemma 12's coupling constant, while removing the proofs of Lemmas 2 and 9 and Appendix B's dual-gap derivation. These substantially revise supporting mathematical content, although the main convergence theorems remain. Appendix A.2 still proves the old Proposition 2.

C1.justification: The abstract and conclusion retain the general inexact ADMM framework, O(1/t) convergence, linear convergence under additional assumptions, and guarantees for NysADMM and sketch-and-solve ADMM. The separate contribution bullet about preconditioning and variable metrics highlights benefits already claimed in v2.

C2.justification: v3 removes the conclusion's discussion of curvature accuracy versus subproblem cost, unresolved local linear convergence, and multiblock extensions with their divergence caveat. Existing interpretations of the experiments and Section 6's qualifications about forcing sequences and damping remain.

D1.justification: v3 removes the explicit subproblem-exactness policy, adaptive PCG tolerance formula, general stopping-criterion description, and Appendix B's dual-feasible-point and relative-gap computations. It also omits the logistic objective and label-encoding explanation. Hardware, sketch sizes and several hyperparameters remain, but information needed to reproduce accuracy control and stopping is substantially reduced.

R1.justification: v3 adds Diamandis et al.'s GeNIOS work and its constrained extension, and adds Zhao et al. (2022) to Table 1. Citations associated with the deleted PCG, multiblock and dual-gap discussions disappear. The broader positioning remains unchanged; the Nyström preconditioning publication update refers to the same work.

P1.justification: Most prose and section order remain intact. v3 revises the author list, switches to author–year citations, separates the curvature discussion into Section 5.1, adds acknowledgments and trims explanatory and future-work passages.

P2.justification: v3 adopts a different document template with a redesigned title and author area, running headers, changed typography and margins, and extensive reflow of equations, tables and figures. Table 1 gains a row, while Figures 1–4 reuse the original panels with changed sizing and placement.

improvement.justification: The corrections in Lemmas 3 and 12 improve mathematical accuracy. However, v3 leaves the revised Definition 4 and Proposition 2 inconsistent with the retained explanation and Appendix A.2 proof, and removes important PCG tolerance and dual-gap computation details. These losses in consistency and reproducibility outweigh the limited editorial and literature updates. The main methods, convergence claims and empirical evidence remain intact.
